description: Finalize Chat Media Upload. Needs the OAuth2 scope `media.write`.

conversation_id.description: The XChat conversation the upload belongs to.

media_hash_key.description: The media hash key returned by the initialize step.

message_id.description: Optional message identifier associated with the upload.

num_parts.description: Total number of uploaded parts, as a numeric string.

ttl_msec.description: Optional TTL for the media in milliseconds, as a numeric string.
